steps.content: Not a single mark appears where your shackles should have bitten. Instead, a deeper, more terrible power pours back into you through them, grinding your insides and splitting you apart from within.
You try to lock your eyes on Lichen's face, yet her features are melting, sliding down in sluggish rivulets.
Your tongue swells, filling your mouth. Broken words scrape past it and fall from your lips. Even you cannot make sense of what you are saying.
Your limbs turn soft and useless. Your arms fall to your sides, swing once, then hang motionless.
[Empty scene 1s + switch special effects]

Your awareness is torn free from your body. Drifting in a daze, you rise and gaze down upon the entire space. Only now do you truly see: the ground beneath your feet was never ground at all. Beneath the scattered slabs of grey stone lie heaps of twisted, blackened limbs, piled layer upon layer.

Bare arms, thighs, slick and shapeless half-torsos... They all extend from the same darkness, crawling in different directions, clutching at anything within reach. It is as though the unspoken words of the dead still animate their flesh and bone, driving them endlessly onward.
And at the center of this vision, a child, utterly pale, is gripped by the collar by a woman whose face is just as grey and cold.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Li... chen...
Those ashen, fractured lips of the child do not stir. Words are no longer within his reach. Only this faint whisper echoes gently in the deepest part of your joined awareness.
steps.female_content: Those ashen, fractured lips of the child do not stir. Words are no longer within her reach. Only this faint whisper echoes gently in the deepest part of your joined awareness.

steps.content: The grip across your chest slackens. The child drops from her hand.
[Vibration + special effects / character art disappears]
Your back sinks into the cold, clinging softness of flesh. Slick limbs swarm toward you all at once, stroking your arms and legs, weaving through your hair. Their touch is ravenous yet eerily tender.

Your vision sharpens at last: Lichen stands above you, gazing down, and takes another step closer. You drag your body backward once more, desperate to escape her and the torrent of twisted, overwhelming Mania force surging from her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Back off!
After that furious shout, all strength drains from your limbs. It feels as if your bones have been pulled clean out, and you fall limply onto your back.
She pauses and studies you closely, her fist tightening in silence. The power slowly recedes but remains coiled around her form, its taint still gnawing at your senses.
She seems to waver for a moment, then tries to edge another step closer.
<b>Why did you stop?
<i>A ghost? The Illusory Moon? Or something else entirely?!
Your breath catches in your throat again. You stare hard into Lichen's eyes. The voice is clearly pushing her forward, coaxing her nearer. If she obeys...
But you are completely drained.
Lichen only offers a small smile and shakes the copper coin free from her sleeve, the one she had been hiding all along.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Oh? Finally decided to speak up? Did you just now figure out this burning little coin is completely useless against me?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Looks like your definition of playing by the rules is quite flexible.

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: We made a promise to find the answers together. You're on the verge of succeeding. Of course I intend to see this through.

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: Though... a phrase comes to mind. "To fall short at the final step."

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Enough with the riddles. What are you trying to say?

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: This child doesn't have much time left, judging by the looks of him...
steps.female_content: This child doesn't have much time left, judging by the looks of her...

steps.content: Lichen offers no reply, her eyes appraising you in silence. The ghostly green ribbon of light wrapped around her arms begins to churn.

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: Or are you planning to simply kill him? What you're after is inside his body, after all.
steps.female_content: Or are you planning to simply kill her? What you're after is inside her body, after all.

steps.content: Lichen's grip tightens around the coin, thumb digging into its edge.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And who said I would stoop so low?

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: "So low"? You've come this far. You've done what needed doing and plenty that didn't. So who exactly are you putting on this virtuous act for?

steps.speaker: Copper Coin
steps.content: What, now of all times you want to earn some good karma? Pray to the heavens—
The copper coin is crushed in two. Fragments of rust sift through her fingers like dust, too pitiful to make the slightest sound.
A faint wisp of smoke rises from her palm, winding briefly between her fingers before drifting away.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Huh?
While her eyes remain on that curling wisp of dark smoke, you seize the moment and drag yourself toward the stone stele.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Get me... out of here...
In a flash, thick black fog surges upward from behind the stone stele. A chorus of countless voices erupts within the mist, rushing toward you and hurling you back against the cold stone.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>To leave... you have to leave something behind...</color><i>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fine, whatever you want... just get me out!

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Yes... yes...!</color><i>

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Then give it to us...!
The dark fog twists in an instant, thickening into a slick, pitch-black mass that lunges straight at you.
<i><color=#7683a2>By the stars I walk; ghosts wail, gods tremble! All foul spirits, seized and delivered to justice!</color><i>
A blade slices through the creature, scattering it into countless flailing limbs. White radiance spills through the widening crack, growing more brilliant with each breath.
Your fingers stretch toward it, nearly brushing its glow, when something seizes your ankle and wrenches you back.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Pay us... pay the price... give it to us!
The grip on your ankle loosens, just barely. Before you can even think to pull away, sharp nails extend from its fingers and slash down toward you.
[Red screen flash + severed limb & blood splatter sound effects]
Lichen stands behind you, her left hand trembling uncontrollably, dripping blood from the blow she took in your stead.

The blackened, rotting limbs latch onto the fresh wound with something close to rapture, burrowing deeper, merging with her flesh. From that unholy union, new skin and sinew, slick and crimson, finally begin to sprout.
She looks at you one last time, her eyes lingering, then turns to confront the creatures. Her hand tightens into a fist as she wrestles with the part of herself she no longer recognizes.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You want a price?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Fine. Come and take it!
The limbs come flooding toward her all at once.
You don't look back. Finally, you cross through the white light and return to the other world.
[CG] Eyes open
The fog in front of you suddenly dissipates. Only then do you catch the gleam of a sword cutting through. As though the fog had been lingering only to be banished by it.
Little guide... Little guide?
I think he's back. Xiansheng, come take a look?
steps.female_content: I think she's back. Xiansheng, come take a look?

steps.content: Worry not. It's going to be fine.

The figure before you sports a mess of curly hair and leans in uncomfortably close. A few paces away stands a long-haired man, his sword already returned to its sheath. He glances sideways at you, his gaze pausing on your face for a beat, then looks away.
All that reaches you is a low, quiet laugh.
[Realm Stele]
The woman turns the broken half of a copper coin idly between her fingers. Its sharp edge scrapes across her skin with each pass, but draws no blood at all.
That blood-red hand has lost all semblance of humanity. It gleams as if forged with golden veins that trace every place the creatures fed.
She flips the half-coin over and holds it up, broken edge raised, toward a shadow standing before her.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So, this is how you've been showing up in the Void of Yin. <color=#fb9259>Anchoring the soul to an object.</color>

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Lyu Buzhou. All those myths and legends I gathered across the land, I shared every last one with you. I assisted your research. I helped you build that Ziwei software. And you? You kept the most crucial discovery to yourself.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Never trusted me, did you? You always think so highly of yourself.
The shadow before her wavers but offers no words.
Her hand drops to her side, and with a careless flick of her fingers, she sends the coin spinning into the mud. It sinks slowly, swallowed without resistance.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: No matter. Person or object, it makes no difference now. Here we all are, in the Void of Yin.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And even without that person, I've already found <color=#fb9259>another path</color>.
